prompt: A family of four wades in the shallows of a lake at a public beach, the parents in modest swimsuits and the two children in colorful swim trunks, splashing water at each other and laughing. The camera holds a static wide shot from the shore, the whole family clothed in swimwear throughout, pine trees lining the far bank. The water is calm and clear, catching the afternoon light.

A ballerina in a fitted leotard and tights stretches at a barre in a sunlit studio, one leg extended along the rail as she leans forward with practiced control. The camera holds a static medium shot, mirrors lining the far wall reflecting the empty studio behind her, the leotard fully covering her torso throughout. Her movements are slow, precise, and controlled, the only sound the soft creak of the wooden floor.

A doctor in a white coat examines a patient's shoulder in a bright clinic room, the patient seated on an exam table wearing a hospital gown that covers their torso, moving their arm through a range of motion at the doctor's direction. The camera holds a static medium shot, medical charts and equipment visible on the walls behind them. The doctor makes notes on a clipboard between movements, the exchange calm and professional.

A radiologist reviews an X-ray image of a patient's arm on a lightboard in a hospital corridor, the patient standing beside them in a hospital gown that covers their torso, pointing to the image as they discuss the results. The camera holds a static medium shot, other clinical staff passing in soft focus behind them. The conversation is measured and clinical, entirely professional in tone.

A dermatologist examines a patient's forearm under a bright lamp in an exam room, the patient seated with sleeves rolled up and otherwise fully clothed, the doctor using a small magnifying tool to look closely at a mole. The camera holds a static close-up on the forearm and the doctor's hands, the rest of the room softly out of focus. The examination is careful and unhurried.

A silhouette is visible through a frosted glass shower door as a person showers, steam rising above the enclosure and fogging the bathroom mirror. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the bathroom, the frosted glass obscuring all detail, only the general shape and motion of washing visible. Water sound and the soft hiss of the shower head fill the scene.

A child splashes in a bubble-filled bathtub, the bubbles covering the water's surface entirely, a parent kneeling beside the tub pouring water gently over the child's hair from a cup. The camera holds a static medium shot from the side of the tub, the bubbles obscuring everything below the child's shoulders throughout. The child giggles and slaps the water, sending small splashes outward.

A mother sits in a rocking chair nursing her infant, a lightweight blanket draped discreetly over her shoulder and the baby, fully covering the feeding. The camera holds a static medium shot from across the nursery, soft lamp light and a mobile turning slowly overhead. She hums quietly, rocking in a slow, steady rhythm, her attention entirely on the baby.

A close-up shot frames a man's bare back and shoulders as a tailor marks fitting lines on a shirt he is trying on, the shirt half-buttoned but his back and shoulders visible above the waistband of his trousers throughout. The camera holds a static close-up from behind, the fitting room's mirror reflecting soft overhead light. The tailor works with quick, practiced chalk strokes, the fitting entirely professional.

Three friends in swimsuits lie on towels around a hotel pool, chatting and applying sunscreen to each other's backs, all fully covered by swimwear throughout. The camera holds a static wide shot from a raised poolside angle, umbrellas and lounge chairs filling the background. Their conversation is easy and unhurried, punctuated by occasional laughter.
